false_positive_case_study.description: Legitimate recursive calls where the same contract appears at multiple call depths. Structural methods incorrectly flag as HIGH_RISK_REENTRANCY. SSTORE analysis finds no cross-depth storage slot writes and correctly outputs NOT_REENTRANCY.

sstore_signals.description: Same slot rewritten across nested frames, depth span >= 2
SSTORE after a mutating CALL boundary
Same (callee, selector) reappears deeper on stack
State write before and after external call, same frame
Same slot written >= 2 times in any context

oz_guard_filter: OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard mutex slots (1->2->1 toggles) are pre-filtered before scoring
fallback_mode: When SSTORE data absent, 3 structural signals apply with 0.75x penalty and 0.80 score cap
